source_quote: The half-life of Ang-AA in rats was 238.7±61.3 min, whereas Ang-(1-7) exhibited a half-life of 2.4±0.6 min (p<0.001, Fig. 2E).
source_location: Results, 'Ang-AA exhibited significantly enhanced stability in vitro and in vivo'; Fig. 2E
route_quote: Twelve SD rats were divided into groups and administered a single intravenous (i.v.) injection of 400 µg/kg Ang-(1-7) or Ang-AA (n=6).
notes: Ang-AA is the acetylated/amidated Ang-(1-7) analogue (not unmodified DRYVIHP).
